description: InkProof analysis contract. The app renders this JSON. The model does not control layout.

fields.mock: boolean. Real provider responses must be false.
fields.model: model id when provider used Gemini, otherwise null
fields.explanation: string. Must not be treated as the full solution.
hints: progressive hints that do not reveal the final answer
fields.finalAnswer: hidden by the app until the student asks
fullSolution: hidden by the app until the student asks
fields.errorCode: MISSING_API_KEY | INVALID_API_KEY | RATE_LIMIT | MODEL_ERROR | NETWORK | TIMEOUT | INVALID_RESPONSE | UPSTREAM | UNSUPPORTED | null
fields.questionId: the only question this payload is about
